entries.description: Specific-gravity scale reading. Reference-temperature conditions are semantic metadata and MUST NOT be invented when absent.
Degrees Plato extract scale. Conversion to specific gravity is a model/table calculation, not a unit conversion.
Brix sucrose mass-fraction scale. A Brix reading on wort or another non-sucrose matrix MUST NOT be relabeled as Plato without an explicit correction/model.
ASBC/SRM beer color index. The numerical index is method-defined and is not a physical color unit.
EBC spectrophotometric beer color index. The numerical index is method-defined and is not a physical color unit.
Lovibond color scale. No generic core conversion to SRM or EBC is defined by FermentationJSON.

Beverage-industry volumes-of-CO2 scale: gas volume relative to beverage volume under stated reference conditions. Conversion to mass concentration requires explicit reference conditions/model provenance.
International bitterness-unit analytical index. It is not identical to iso-alpha-acid mass concentration or perceived bitterness.
